# `system_profile` tools

5 tools in the `system_profile` operation domain. This reference covers every tool the server registers, including the ones a default deployment does not expose. See the [tool reference index](index.md) for every domain.

The Summary column on each domain page is the first line of the tool's MCP description. The complete text, including the conditions under which a tool refuses, is the tool handler's docstring under `src/hmcpctl/server_tools/`. An MCP client's `tools/list` carries that docstring's prose as the description and its argument detail in the input schema; `Returns:` and `Raises:` sections are not sent.

| Tool | Effect | Operation | Target | Implementation | Verification | Runtime eligibility | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hmc_activate_system_profile` | `destructive` | `system_profile.activate` | `managed_system` | `partial` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Validate or activate once, preserving native facts and bounded member witnesses. |
| `hmc_create_system_profile` | `mutate` | `system_profile.create` | `managed_system` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Create one system profile from explicit contained partition/profile pairs. |
| `hmc_delete_system_profile` | `destructive` | `system_profile.delete` | `managed_system` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Delete one exact system profile through the fixed documented CLI route. |
| `hmc_list_system_profiles` | `read` | `system_profile.list` | `managed_system` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Read complete system-profile membership before optional exact-name lookup. |
| `hmc_update_system_profile` | `mutate` | `system_profile.update` | `managed_system` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Rename, replace membership, or both after authorizing the old/new member union. |
